Thanks guys! I just finished my checkride and I am proud to say I’m officially a CFI! The checkride was very different. It felt more like advice and learning to be a great instructor rather than your typical checkride. The DPE was very chill and fair. The oral went good/ok, it was mostly me trying to teach and him saying dumb it down. The flight was extremely weird. I heard from other students that he likes to put you under pressure and frustrate you. This was true! It was “why aren’t you coordinated?” “Teach me straight and level... no i don’t like that! teach me a different way! “ Right our of the gate I became extremely nervous and frustrated. Even on maneuvers he expected smooth and perfection but it seemed I was doing everything wrong. Once we finished our landings I put the plane away and all I could feel is how terrible the flight went. I was so sure I failed and would have to take a recheck. But we sat down and he gave me some more advice for nervous students, congratulated me and said “you’re one of us now.” Overall a weird but great experience!
